zh: 魂的方案新增「外观来源」。默认跟随本体，选「分身独立」可固定默认服装、保留召唤魂原模型或使用绝影分身模型。保存后，按钮和快捷键召唤的新魂都会使用这项设置。
新增「召唤时定格」。穿好一套衣服召一只魂，再换装召下一只，每只都会保留自己出生时已显示的装束和染色。排队召唤同样按每只实际出生时取外观。
修复跟随本体时，本体的染色在分身出生后才加载，分身一直停在默认色的问题。分批复查可读取的材质参数，并保留其他 Mod 已接管的分身材质槽。
七星剑阵：大师兄和悲痛欲绝的阿瑾在卡片选择「配合阵容：带队」后，召到红蓝擂台会各带六名队员。大师兄使用原版七人起手阵，阿瑾在首次迎敌时使用梅谷湖的「爆脸转化」。同场多组各认自己的队员。
剑阵 AI 可以按原版条件让同组弟子献血，为受伤的主将恢复生命。大师兄也能选中符合复活条件的白衣弟子，接原版起身和回血动作。
大师兄和阿瑾整组阵亡后，会清理长期留在场上的本组遗体。主将先倒时，活着的小弟继续战斗；组内发生复活会重新计时。
整队接力开战后，即使首批有单位还没锁定对手，后续候补也会保留，本方这一批打完后照常补位。
烈焰的桩挤在一起时，拿到狮头的 NPC 现在可以在起跳途中连续避开多根木桩，并在落脚前恢复桩体碰撞。
修复随从弹体换目标失败却仍报告成功的问题。梦华的攻击弹会核对自己锁定的敌人，仍指向玩家或空目标时放弃这次锁定。
对手确认阵亡后，参战 NPC 会在当前动作结束后清掉仍指向它的锁定。这也适用于最后一个敌人倒下的情况。
多人擂台减少重复查询。阿瑾和大师兄多组同场时会共用一次场上名单核对。修复剑阵召唤中断后可能留下隐藏物件的问题，清场遇到游戏暂时拒绝时会稍后重试。
开启免仇恨观战时，助手会减少全图搜索，继续逐批检查敌人是否锁定玩家。切换地图会立即刷新，刚用助手召出的敌人也会立即处理。
诊断包现在会记录梦华随从的攻击弹打中了谁、冷荼持续隐身时的本体状态，以及玉鼎斩杀时对手有没有打出精闪。
en: Choose an appearance source in Hun’s profile. Follow player is the default. Independent clone can wear the default outfit, keep the summoned NPC model, or use the Shadow Double mesh. Summon buttons and hotkeys use the saved choice for new clones.

Choose Capture on summon in Hun’s appearance settings. Wear one outfit, summon Hun, then change before summoning the next. Each clone keeps the outfit and dye visible when it spawns, including queued summons.
Hun now picks up supported dye and material changes that finish loading after a summon. Checks are spread across clones and leave material slots taken over by other mods alone.

Enable Entourage on the card for the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation or Grief-Stricken Jin to bring six disciples into the arena. The Chief Disciple opens with the seven-person formation. Jin performs her ambush transformation on first engaging an opponent. Each party has its own members.

The sword formations use the game’s conditions for members to sacrifice HP and heal their leader. The Chief Disciple can also select a fallen white-robed disciple for the original revival and recovery sequence.
Lingering bodies are cleaned up after the eldest disciple’s or Ajin’s entire formation falls. Surviving members keep fighting if the leader dies first. A revival restarts the cleanup timer.
Once a relay fight starts, reserves stay queued even if some opening fighters take longer to acquire a target. Replacements enter when their wave is defeated.
In Flame’s pole arena, the fighter wearing the lion head can clear several overlapping posts in one jump. The landing post supports the fighter again before touchdown.

Companion projectiles now verify their target after a failed redirect. If a Menghua projectile still points at the player or has no target, the selector retries the enemy and rejects an unconfirmed lock.
Arena fighters release a lingering lock on a defeated opponent once their current action finishes, including when the last enemy falls.

Crowded arena fights need fewer checks, and Ajin’s and the Chief Disciple’s formations share one battlefield roster scan. Interrupted summons now clean up hidden formation actors. If the game temporarily refuses cleanup, the assistant retries after a short delay.

With no-aggro enabled, the assistant searches the map less often while continuing to check enemies for a lock on the player. It refreshes on map changes and handles enemies summoned by the assistant immediately.
Diagnostics now record who was hit by companion Menghua’s projectiles, Lengtu’s mesh state during prolonged invisibility, and NPC perfect dodges during Yuding’s execution grab.

zh: 修复魂在换装延迟加载时头身错位的问题。整套外观对齐后才切换，骨架不合时保留原外观。
多只魂同时检查换装时共用一次玩家外观读取。其他外观 Mod 替换分身身体后，助手会撤下旧部件，避免旧头部重新出现或卸载时改回旧模型。
多只魂同场时会错开武器判断，每只魂仍按原有间隔出招。魂偶尔读不到目标或战斗计时未能启动时会重试，重生后会忽略上一条命留下的回调。
魂的喝药动作在启动过程中被打断时，会保留这次药量。药已耗尽时减少重复读取。死亡标记仍在时，短暂回血也不会反复开启黑魔伤的重生等待。
修复魂的影之武装接第二段时，已被打断或已换目标仍接着出招的问题。延迟启动的后续招式也会核对原来的对手。
修复了序章左殇或梦华在擂台挨玉鼎的斩杀投后，明明还活着却一直倒地或陷在慢动作里的问题。对手受阶段锁血保护时，玉鼎会使用普通投。
修复了关闭梦华的剧情联动后，重新召唤她并开战，双方有时仍站在原地不动的问题。
修复了断魂山银发左殇在红蓝对战中放金色剑雨时，剑雨有时会落向旁观玩家的问题。剑雨现在会跟随左殇的对手。
修复了最终战魔渊进入二阶段时战斗音乐可能中断的问题。使用原版音乐或让助手自动选曲时，都能接续二阶段曲目。
修复随从卡在战斗状态后站着不动的问题。卡住时重试追敌，目标消失后重新索敌或跟随玩家。
普通随从活动时，助手优先检查直属召唤物，减少整图扫描。多条召唤记录给出冲突的阵营时，等归属明确后再接管。
进入地图或手动刷新目录时，助手会分批读取图鉴、刷怪配置和单位等级。单项读取失败会重试，面板指令仍能响应。状态没有变化时也减少了重复写盘。
自定义 AI 参数分批核对。已经通过游戏回调生效的数值不再反复查询，被游戏改回的数值会单独恢复。
修复已被占用的旧快捷键阻止保存其他快捷键的问题。有冲突的绑定会在对应功能下提示，其他空闲按键可以正常保存。
自定义难度现在能正确识别未达到门槛的单位。进图后分次查找难度规则，已经核实的单位减少重复查询。
战斗音乐、血条或诊断读取偶尔出错时，战斗和增援仍会继续。出错的功能稍后自动重试。卸载时也会逐项停止快捷键和战斗回调。
反复进出自由观战后，旧镜头回调不会再移动新镜头。连续传送时，已结束的观察不会干扰下一次传送，防坠保护到期后会立即停止拉回。
en: Fixed split heads and bodies on late-loading Hun outfits. A new outfit is shown only once its pose matches.
Simultaneous Hun outfit checks share one player lookup. If another mod replaces a clone’s body, the assistant removes its old parts and preserves the replacement on unload.

Groups of Hun stagger their weapon checks while keeping each fighter’s usual interval. Failed timer starts and transient decision errors retry. Callbacks from a previous life can no longer issue inputs after revival.

An interruption before the drinking animation finishes starting now preserves the charge. An empty flask skips redundant checks. Brief HP gains while Hun is still marked dead no longer reopen the rebirth window.
Hun now drops a Shadow Weapon follow-up if the chain was interrupted or its opponent changed. Delayed follow-ups also check the original target before continuing.
Fixed prologue Zuo Shang and Meng Hua staying down or moving in slow motion after surviving Yuding’s lethal grab in the arena. Yuding uses her regular grab while their phase HP floor is active.
Fixed both sides sometimes standing idle at the start of a fight after Meng Hua was summoned with story assists disabled.
Fixed golden sword rain from silver-haired Zuo Shang of Mount Soulrend sometimes landing on the spectating player during Blue vs Red battles. The rain now follows his opponent.
Fixed battle music cutting out when final-battle Mo Yuan enters phase two. His second-phase theme now continues in both Native and Auto modes.
Fixed stalled companions. They retry pursuit, seek a new enemy or follow the player when a target is gone.
Companions check directly owned summons between map sweeps. Conflicting records must agree on the summon’s side before the assistant adopts it.

The assistant loads the codex, spawns and unit levels in separate steps when entering a map or refreshing the catalog. Commands still work if a read fails, and unchanged status uses fewer disk writes.
Custom AI settings are checked in batches. Values confirmed through the game callback skip redundant reads, and a changed value is repaired individually.
A conflicting saved hotkey now shows an error on its own action. You can still save free keys for other actions.
Custom difficulty now recognizes units below a difficulty threshold. Rule lookups run on separate updates, and verified units need fewer repeat checks.
Fights and reinforcements continue if music, health bars or diagnostics encounter a read error. The affected feature retries later. Hotkeys and battle callbacks are stopped individually on unload.
Re-entering free spectate no longer lets an old camera callback move the new view. An expired teleport watch can no longer act on a later trip or pull you back after fall protection ends.

zh: 补齐龙柱第 2、3、4 战的魔渊。现在五战都能单独召唤，各自使用原版数值和招式。 第一战的金面具黑衣人可以在卡面关闭虚化，下次召唤生效。
最终战魔渊在红蓝擂台开战也会响起原版战斗曲。~~进入二阶段时切歌，~~战后恢复场景音乐。
烈焰召出小狮子后，对手会先清她这一波。谁处决最后一只、戴上狮头，谁就上桩挑战她。同场多组烈焰各自配对。 首跳受阻时，NPC 会换方向重试。
毕峰的残血终结抓现在允许 NPC 反制。被抓者优先，无法行动时，附近正在交战的队友也有机会接手。玉鼎的斩杀投则需要 NPC 对这一下打出精准闪避，才能接上收尾。
魂自动处决 NPC 时会看对手剩余血量，默认常态 10%、破防 20%。两项都能自定义，填 0 可关闭对应状态的自动处决。
AI「全部拉满」同时强化进攻和闪避，四组共 65 项参数仍可单独调整。用过旧预设的玩家，重新点一次「全部拉满 → 保存并应用」即可。
修复魔渊二阶段砸火柱被打断后，火柱特效跟着他移动的问题。
修复角色下坠时把半空误记为安全落点的问题。 双方一起坠落时会尝试返回已确认的地面，跟踪镜头向下移动时也会检查地形。
修正桌面快捷方式和助手版本号显示过旧的问题。
en: Added Mó Yuan’s second, third and fourth Dragon Pillar trials. All five encounters can now be summoned separately with their original stats and moves. The Gold-Masked One’s card lets you turn off his trial protection for the next summon.
The final-trial Mó Yuan can now play his native boss theme in the arena. ~~The music changes in phase two.~~ The map soundtrack returns when the fight ends.

Flame’s opponents now go after her cubs first. The fighter who executes the last cub and gets the lion head earns the pole duel against that Flame, even with multiple groups in the arena. NPCs can retry a blocked first jump from another direction.

NPCs can counter Bi Feng’s low-health grab. The grabbed fighter has first chance, and an engaged teammate nearby can respond if it cannot act. Against Yuding’s execution grab, the NPC must perfect-dodge that attack to perform the counter.
Hun’s automatic executions now check the target’s remaining HP. The defaults are 10% normally and 20% during guard break. Both are adjustable. Set either to 0 to disable executions in that state.
Max everything now boosts attacks and dodges together. All 65 settings can still be adjusted individually or by group. To replace an old preset, choose Max everything, then Save and apply.
Fixed the pillar effect following summoned Mó Yuan when his phase-two slam is interrupted.

Fixed a mid-air position being saved as a safe landing point during a fall. If both fighters fall, recovery can use a previously confirmed floor. The tracking camera now checks the terrain as it follows a target downward.
Fixed outdated version labels in the desktop shortcut and assistant.

zh: 新增试验功能「传送」。9 张地图共 121 个地点，包括各 Boss 场地和流程过后回不去的场景。点一下就传，走游戏自己的加载，可以返回传送前的位置。每个地点和「返回」都能单独绑快捷键，在游戏里按一次就传送。
传送很可能让游戏立刻按新位置存档，使用前请先备份存档。到位后 15 秒内如果掉出地面，会被拉回落点。剧情已过的场景里可能没有怪，也可能没有出口，出不去可以用钟或返回传送前的位置。自由观战中不能传送。
魂会照你当前这一身来穿，包括游戏内换的服装和外观 Mod 换掉的部件。读不到时用默认外观。
修正装了主角服装类 Mod 后，召出来的魂有时打不中的问题。
新增「可以穿过随从」开关，默认开启。在窄路里不会再被随从堵住，敌人仍然会被随从挡住，受击判定不变。
随从魂可以处决敌人，小怪和 Boss 都行。小怪优先用魂手上那把武器的处决动作，其次是通用处决动作；Boss 用它自己的处决动作。没有合适处决动作的敌人也会处决，这时对方可能不播被处决动作，只是原地停住。你正在处决或处决过的目标不会被抢。
新增「随从处决小怪」开关，默认关闭。打开后，小怪能被处决时附近的随从也会上去处决。
修正随从出招的瞬间丢失目标时，技能可能锁回玩家的问题。随从银发左殇放大招时不会再强制玩家走路。
随从银发左殇的金色剑雨仍可能拐向玩家。上一版写的修正在随从打地图上的怪时没有生效，这一版没有修好，只补了保险和排查用的日志。
传送页、地点名和新开关都提供英文。
本版已通过 213 项自动检查。以上各项都还没有在游戏里复核。
en: New experimental feature: Teleport. 121 places across 9 maps, including boss arenas and areas the story no longer lets you return to. One click teleports you through the game's own loading screen, and you can return to where you were. Each place and Return can have its own hotkey; in the game, one press teleports.

Teleporting very likely makes the game save at the new position right away, so back up your save first. If you fall through the ground within 15 seconds of arriving, you are put back at the landing point. An area whose story is over may have no enemies and no exit; use a bell or Return to get out. You cannot teleport while spectating.
Hun now wears what you are wearing, including outfits changed in the game and parts replaced by appearance mods. If your outfit cannot be read, he uses the default look.
Fixed summoned Hun sometimes being impossible to hit when a player outfit mod was installed.
New switch: Walk through companions, on by default. Companions no longer box you in on narrow paths. Enemies are still blocked by them, and hit detection is unchanged.

A companion Hun can now execute enemies, minions and bosses alike. On a minion he prefers the execution of the weapon in his hand, then the generic one; on a boss he uses the boss's own. He also executes enemies that have no fitting execution animation; they may stand still instead of playing a reaction. He never takes a target you are executing or have executed.
New switch: Companions execute minions, off by default. When on, a nearby companion also goes in once a minion can be executed.

Fixed companion skills that could lock back onto the player when the companion lost its target for a moment as the skill started. A companion silver-haired Zuo Shang's ultimate no longer forces the player to walk.

A companion silver-haired Zuo Shang's golden sword rain can still veer toward the player. The fix in the previous version did not take effect when a companion fights enemies on the map. It is not fixed in this version, which only adds safeguards and diagnostic logging.
The Teleport page, its place names and the new switches are available in English.
This version passed 213 automated checks. None of the items above has been rechecked in the game yet.

zh: 七星剑阵大师兄、阿瑾、小雪、玉面郎君、玉瓒、碧海大师残躯和荡秽这 7 张 Boss 卡新增「配合阵容」，下次召唤生效。
想单挑就选「单体」。想看七星剑阵，就给大师兄选「带队」，他会带六名弟子上场~~，按原版条件发动配合招式~~。玉面郎君能带上金面和铁面，小雪也能在战斗中召出小弟。红蓝擂台按整队判胜负，Boss 先倒下，活着的队员会继续打。
天气可以直接点选，也可以一键切到指定天气。 在支持天气控制的地图上，可选择晴天、雷雨、暴雪、沙尘暴等 13 种原版天气。每种天气都能单独绑键，「上一个」「下一个」「恢复原天气」也各有快捷键。
可以从角色自己的视角看对战。 观战目标可选玩家本人或召唤出来的 NPC。想看魂怎么接下对面那一刀，可以直接切到他的视角。玩家和 NPC 的第一人称观战入口都能单独绑键。
普通格挡改用原版持续防御，精准防御保留原版回杀气效果。顶部杀气条会短暂显示刚刚净掉了多少杀气，方便看清一次交锋的结果。
修正部分走跑动画缺失造成的滑步，以及命中停顿时过早接下一刀的问题。零冷却换武后，魂会先尝试用手里的武器出招。遇到放不出的战技，会继续尝试当前可用的招式。
对手短暂进入处决保护时，魂可以保留已经开始的影武蓄力。另修正了喝药被停顿打断后仍消耗、死亡后饰品继续回血，以及重生后部分外观仍然隐藏的问题。
召唤魂会使用已保存的配装和数量。用快捷键召魂后，擂台里原先选好的怪物仍可照常召唤。
修正随从银发左殇对剧情怪释放金色剑雨时，部分剑光可能拐向玩家的问题。出招后短暂丢失目标会重新确认原来的敌人，晚出现的剑光也会补查。两名左殇同场时各追各的对手。
修正多名骑兵在同一地点召唤时可能认错马的问题。荆野的马晚出现也能被识别，红蓝擂台上的坐骑追错敌人后会重新跟上骑手的目标。玩家手动锁不住荆野的反馈仍待实机复现。
补齐魂的装备、策略、阶段和快捷键等页面的英文。即使游戏未连接，擂台图鉴里的 191 个单位、章节和地图也能显示英文名称。
减少多人混战时重复查找目标的开销。赞赏页新增 Patreon 境外通道和配图，微信二维码在左，Patreon 在右。
本版已通过 208 项自动检查。随从剑雨在游戏里的实际落点、魂连续拼刀时的动作衔接，以及长时间混战的流畅度，仍待实机复核。
en: Seven boss cards now have an Entourage setting that applies to your next summon: the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation, Grief-Stricken Jin, Corpse-Eating Xue, Jade-Face, Yuzan, Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple, and Dusk the Puppeteer.

Choose Solo for a duel. To see the Seven-Stars Formation, enable the Chief Disciple’s entourage. Six disciples join him~~ and can perform their joint moves when the game’s usual conditions are met~~. Jade-Face can bring Gold Mask and Iron Mask, and Xue can summon minions during combat. In Blue vs Red battles, surviving teammates keep fighting after their boss falls.

Pick the weather directly or give a preset its own hotkey. Maps with weather controls offer 13 native presets, including clear skies, thunderstorms, blizzards, and sandstorms. Previous, Next, and Restore Original Weather can each have their own hotkey.

Watch a fight through a character’s eyes. Spectate the player or a summoned NPC in first person. Switch to Hun’s view to see how he meets an incoming strike. Player and NPC views have separate hotkeys.
Regular blocks now use the game’s held guard. Perfect guards retain their native Sha-Chi recovery. The top Sha-Chi bar briefly shows the net loss from the last exchange.

Fixed cases where Hun slid because a walking or running animation was missing, or queued his next strike during hit stop. After a zero-cooldown weapon switch, he gets a chance to attack with the new weapon. When a combat art is unavailable, he can try another move he can use.

Hun can hold a shadow armament charge already in progress while his opponent is briefly protected during an execution. Fixed interrupted potion use still consuming a charge, accessories healing Hun after death, and parts of his appearance staying hidden after revival.
Summoning Hun uses his saved loadout and count. Using a Hun hotkey keeps the monster you selected in the arena ready for your next summon.

Fixed a targeting issue that could send a companion silver-haired Zuo Shang’s golden sword rain toward the player when he attacked a story enemy. The volley rechecks its enemy if it briefly loses its target and picks up late-appearing swords. Two Zuo Shangs can track separate opponents.

Fixed riders claiming the wrong horse when several were summoned at the same spot. Jing Ye’s mount can be recognized even if it appears late. In Blue vs Red battles, a mount that chases the wrong opponent can return to its rider’s target. Reports that players cannot manually lock onto Jing Ye still need in-game reproduction.
Added missing English text for Hun’s equipment, strategy, phases, and hotkeys. All 191 arena units, along with their chapter and map names, can now be shown in English while the game is disconnected.
Reduced repeated target lookups in group battles. The Support page now shows the WeChat QR code on the left and an illustrated Patreon link for international supporters on the right.

This version passed 208 automated checks. Sword-rain impact positions in companion fights, Hun’s animation transitions across successive clashes, and performance in long group battles still need in-game verification.

zh: 新增可自定义的「魂」。在「粪怪」页保存方案后，可召到蓝方、红方、设为随从，或选「与我对战」。四种召唤方式可以分别绑定快捷键。排队的魂保留入队时的方案，后来修改只影响新请求。
魂的装备目录包含 33 件主武器、28 件影之武装、17 项特殊装备和 73 件饰品。可配置主武器轮换、武器技能、影武蓄力、血量阶段、精防、闪避、喝药和重生规则。饰品可选未精炼或更高档位。
红蓝方的魂按擂台对手行动，随从可跟随玩家。调整了魂出生时的装备初始化、血量与杀气显示，以及清场时对武器、外观部件和影武召唤物的归属检查。
改进多人战斗的索敌和增援。对手处于处决等暂时无敌状态时保留原配对；对手死亡或离场后重新选敌。铁鬼与玉妖作为随从攻击同一目标时可触发连携，玉璧在满足原版招式条件时可对随从或擂台模式中的敌人施放电墙。
怪物池支持按卡片召唤和记住数量。新增战斗音乐设置，可选原生曲目，也可为指定 Boss 配置本地音频。Boss 卡片可调整自动处决小怪的开关与概率。
减少助手定期刷新图鉴、选卡及排队时的重复读取。100 份满配魂排队的离线测试中，单次状态刷新中位数从约 11 毫秒降到约 2 毫秒。修复召唤结果被后续操作挤出列表后，按钮一直等待的问题。大批满配魂同场的帧时间和长局稳定性仍待实机验证。
en: Create a custom Hun profile, then summon him to Blue or Red, bring him along as a companion, or challenge him yourself. Each action has its own optional hotkey. Queued summons keep the profile they had when queued.

The profile includes 33 main weapons, 28 shadow armaments, 17 special equipment entries and 73 accessories. Configure weapon rotation and skills, charged armament attacks, health-based phases, parries, dodges, healing and revival. Accessories now support refinement level zero.

Arena Hun fighters target their opponents, while companion Hun can follow the player. This update improves equipment setup at spawn, health and Sha-Chi displays, and ownership checks when weapons, cosmetic parts or summoned minions are cleaned up.

Group fights and reinforcements handle target changes more reliably. Fighters retain their matchups while an opponent is temporarily invulnerable during an execution and can pick a new opponent after death or departure. The Iron Ghost and Jade Fiend companions can use their joint attack against a shared target. Yu Bi can cast her electric wall against a companion's or arena fighter's opponent when her native move conditions are met.

Summon from individual monster-pool cards and remember their counts. Choose native battle tracks or assign local audio to selected bosses. Boss cards also let you adjust how often a boss automatically executes minor enemies.

The helper does less repeated work when refreshing the catalog, selecting fighters and polling the queue. With 100 fully equipped Hun profiles queued in an offline test, median status polling fell from about 11 ms to about 2 ms. Summon controls now recover their result even after it leaves the recent history. In-game frame times with large groups and long-session stability still need testing.

zh: 新增“禁止脱战回血”开关，默认关闭、保留原版。开启后拦截模组管理单位的原版脱战逐步回血和立即回满，已有与新召唤单位均生效；技能回血、吸血和地图原生单位保持原样。已回的血不扣回，关闭也不补回此前拦截的血量。
弦者卡片新增“技能虚化无敌”选项，默认原版。关闭后保留动作、位移和特效，移除对应技能的无敌保护；蓝方、红方、随从和未配队均适用，下次直召生效。
改进梦华的原生剧情阶段适配：分别记录每次召唤的梦华与虚空配对及落点，减少多组同场、晚加载剧情对象和阶段收尾互相干扰。默认保留原版41%阶段保护及联动，确认原生收尾后才清理对应配对。
梦华卡片新增“剧情联动：保留／跳过”开关，默认保留、下次直召生效。选择跳过会连同虚空联动、41%阶段保护和联动专用招式一起跳过；地图剧情、其他血量下限与“不倒下”不受此选项控制。
索敌挂钩晚加载、部分注册失败或注销未确认时继续限频处理；控制器、组件或对象身份变化后重新核对。私有锁定目标写入后读回，未知结果不再当作已经成功清锁，失败目标指派会重试。
补齐尸体索敌修订的遗漏：同一轮处理期间单位死亡、目标变得不可选或停止清理后，发原生指令前重新确认，不再继续向已离场的旧名单下令。早期0.40.3中对应的过度完整修复说明已划掉。
修复死亡随从仍被助战、跟随或移动指令驱动，以及新单位复用地址时沿用旧随从状态或镜头分类缓存的问题。血量读不清时暂缓控制并保留恢复记录；镜头目标离场后释放对应缓存。
减少支持循环内重复的视口、对象名单及目标查询；无随从时跳过无用玩家查询，战斗名单按变动更新索引，无删除时不再复制整张名单。随从血条重建或原生状态重置后重新刷新。
新增可自定义的“解散全部随从”快捷键，位于“快捷键 → 随从”，默认未绑定。支持组合键、保存、解绑及与单位／怪物池按键的冲突检查；只走随从解散流程，蓝方、红方和未配队单位保留。换图后的旧按键请求会取消。
后续界面和更新说明维护中文、英文。原日语、法语、德语、西班牙语用户升级后，会显示各自语言的说明并暂用英文；语言设置旁始终保留四语说明，顶栏语言菜单可直接到达。需要其他语言维护，可提GitHub Issue或邮件联系，哪怕只有一位用户需要也会恢复该语言更新。
本版新增选项、状态提示及已知的相关指令答复已补齐中英。旧语言设置和历史公告保留迁移信息；旧快捷键文件保留原绑定，新增解散键为空。旧版游戏内模组尚未支持解散键时明确提示更新，原有按键仍可设置。
已通过152组离线回归、108个Lua语法及NPC／Actor双启动检查，并在浏览器原型验证语言弹窗、设置入口和解散键绑定。离线重复查询计数降低不等于实测游戏帧率提升；禁止脱战回血、游戏内的解散随从快捷键、梦华连携、虚化、长战索敌、帧时间及不同NPC组合仍需实机验证。
已知风险：旧式生命／杀气下限恢复记录的热重载对象身份风险仍未迁移。重载前先遣散梦华随从，关闭无仇恨、不倒下与无限杀气，停止清理并确认恢复；无法确认时先保留诊断并退出游戏，不用热重载代替清理。菜单滚轮失效反馈仍待复现。
en: Added Prevent out-of-combat healing, off by default. When enabled it blocks native gradual regeneration and instant full healing outside combat for existing and newly summoned mod-managed units. Healing skills, life steal and native map actors are unchanged. Health already restored is not removed, and disabling the option does not refund blocked healing.

Xian Zhe cards now offer Skill invulnerability, with native behavior as the default. Turning it off removes the corresponding skill protection while keeping animations, movement and effects. Applies to subsequent standalone summons on blue, red, companion or no team.

Improved Meng Hua’s native story-phase adaptation. Each summon tracks its own Xu Kong partner and landing anchors to reduce interference between simultaneous groups, streamed story actors and phase cleanup. Native 41% phase protection and the linked moves remain the default; the corresponding pair is cleaned up after native completion is confirmed.

Meng Hua cards now offer Story link: keep / skip, with keep as the default. Skipping also skips the Xu Kong link, its 41% phase protection and exclusive linked moves. Applies to subsequent direct summons. Map story actors, other health floors and Undying are not controlled by this option.

Targeting hooks continue paced recovery after late loading, partial registration failure or unconfirmed removal. Controller, component and actor identity changes are checked again. Private target writes are read back; an unknown result no longer counts as a cleared lock, and failed assignments are retried.

Closed gaps in corpse targeting: actors can die, become untargetable or leave during one processing pass. Native commands now recheck that state and do not continue using a roster retired by cleanup. The corresponding overly broad fix claim in 0.40.3 has been struck through.

Dead companions no longer receive assist, follow or movement commands. Replacement actors at reused addresses no longer inherit old companion state or camera classifications. Unknown health pauses control while retaining recovery records, and departed camera targets release their cached classification.

Reduced repeated viewport, actor-list and target queries within support ticks. Idle companion updates skip unnecessary player queries; combat roster lookups use an index invalidated on changes, and pruning avoids copying an unchanged list. Companion bars refresh after widget reconstruction or native state resets.

Added a configurable Dismiss all companions hotkey under Hotkeys → Companions, unbound by default. Supports modifier chords, saving, unbinding and conflicts with unit or monster-pool keys. Uses companion-only dismissal; blue, red and no-team units stay. Queued presses from an old map are cancelled.

Future interface updates and release notes will be maintained in Chinese and English. Japanese, French, German and Spanish users receive a notice in their language after upgrading, then temporarily use English. All four notices remain beside the language settings and are reachable from the top language menu. Request another language through a GitHub issue or email; even one user is enough to resume support.

New options, status text and known related command replies are available in Chinese and English. Migration information and historical translations are retained. Existing hotkey files keep their bindings and the new dismissal key starts unbound. Older in-game mods show an update requirement for dismissal while their existing hotkeys remain editable.

Passed 152 offline regression groups, syntax checks for 108 Lua files and both NPC/Actor startup fixtures. Browser prototype checks cover language notices, settings access and dismissal-key binding. Lower query counts are not measured game FPS gains. Blocking out-of-combat regeneration, the in-game companion dismissal key, native linked phases, phasing, long fights, frame times and individual NPC combinations still need in-game validation.

Known risk: the old health/Sha-Chi floor recovery format still has actor-identity risks across hot reloads. Before reloading, dismiss Meng Hua companions, disable No aggro, Undying and Infinite Sha-Chi, then stop and clean up and confirm recovery. If recovery cannot be confirmed, retain diagnostics and exit the game instead of hot reloading. The menu-wheel report still needs reproduction.
